title: A paraphrase above the strictness is a hit, and the score is shown
goal: For {{castBrand}}, {{castApp}} rarely asks in exactly the same words. While {{castTask}}, the same question comes in slightly different wording.
obstacle: An exact-match cache would miss every rewording, so the saving would be small.
control: The key compares the new prompt with earlier ones and the result shows the score and the entry it matched. In this lab the encoder is a stand-in that measures shared words, not meaning, so a paraphrase scores high only when it reuses them.
